text_block_list.text:
One day, I met up with the proprietress and young proprietress
after they finished their errands, and we went for a stroll――

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
The discussions with our client wrapped up smoothly.
We can breathe easy now♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, quite so.
This will keep the inn secure for a while.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...However, Yunohana.
Your bow earlier was slightly delayed, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This is a world that values etiquette.
You can't let a moment like that slip by.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...!
I apologize, Proprietress.

Still, it shows how closely she pays attention to every detail
so she'll be prepared when taking over as landlady.
The warmth in her voice makes that abundantly clear.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Well, as long as you understand, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's all our business done for today.
Now that I've caught up with you,
how about we let loose a bit—

text_block_list.name: Flushed Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the landlady of Yukoma!
Rare to see you walking around at this hour...
*hic*!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Oh my... To run into you in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's Gen-sama, the legendary drinker who is said to have drunk every hot spring town dry!

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text: Oh, stop, you're laying it on too thick! So, what do you say, Ma'am? Care to join me? My treat!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a lovely invitation.
However... I'm afraid I must decline.
I have quite a low tolerance for alcohol, you see.

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right.
Forgive me, even though you told me before...

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text:
I'm hopeless... Drink, get carried away, forget...
I screw up every single time...

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to watch out for alcohol harassment and stuff...
Seriously... it's always like this...
Fossils left behind by the times, all of them...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Heavens no, please do not get the wrong idea.
It just so happens to be how my body is built.

The old man is utterly crestfallen and deep in self-reflection.
With no one to blame, the heavy atmosphere feels all the more heartbreaking.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if it really is just one cup...—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Right awayyy♪
Allow me, the young proprietress, to be your opponent!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's drink up!
Yours truly, the "Bottomless Barrel of the Spa," will gladly keep you company all night~!

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text:
Young mistress, you can handle your liquor that well?!
No, wait, we shouldn't push her too hard...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I just consider myself lucky to have
an excuse for a drink.
Let's have a fun chat!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Just between us, though. When the proprietress gets drunk, she turns super adorable.
That's why she can't drink out in public.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yunohana!
Keep your nose out of business that isn't yours!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Ufufufu.

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hahaha!
Was that something I shouldn't have asked?

text_block_list.name: Gen
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, you're up, young lady! Let's see you drink like a fish! Hey, whoever's with her, feel free to join in!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Okaay♪ Well Trainer, 
let's take them up on that delicious treat!
choice_data_list: Well then, don't mind if I join you...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thoroughly satisfied, thoroughly satisfied.
I ended up taking full advantage of your kindness
and ate quite a feast~.
choice_data_list: Considering that, your expression hasn't changed at all...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Fufu, surprised? Thanks to this, no one ever notices when I'm sneaking a sip.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Quit with the nasty jokes already!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...No, you really saved me this time.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was really nothing worth thanking me for.
I'm just happy if I was able to help the landladyâª

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thanks.
...Just one thing, though.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
When on earth are you going to learn
what you should and shouldn't say...!?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufu.
I do this deliberately, so there is nothing to fix~

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: You really are something else...!

Their banter was far too lighthearted and lively
to be called a typical mentor-student dynamic.
Watching the two of them support each other brought a smile to my face.
